description: Demonstrates the role+metadata refinement AshwinUgale raised on Discussion #45 (proposed, not yet finalized): muteval's real per-mutant 'survived' outcome isn't one thing -- a survivor is either a genuine coverage gap or an inert/equivalent mutant muteval excludes from its effective mutation score, so a consumer reconstructing that effective score from group.role alone would get muteval's raw score instead. This fixture is the real-coverage-gap branch: role stays the coarse, conventional 'survived' verdict, while metadata.output_changed (reusing muteval's own MutantOutcome field name from runner.py, rather than inventing new spec vocabulary) carries the finer distinction a rollup-reconstructing consumer needs. See spec/conformance/fixtures/group_role_metadata_inert_survivor_valid.json for the paired inert-mutant case.
